exposure: Free cortisol (FC) levels during late pregnancy
Free cortisol index (FCI) during late pregnancy
outcome: Postpartum stress scores (using Perceived Stress Scale)
Postpartum depression scores (using Beck Depression Inventory)
Postpartum anxiety scores (using Beck Anxiety Inventory)
cohort: A total of 77 healthy pregnant subjects were evaluated.
finding: Higher free cortisol (FC) levels and increased free cortisol index (FCI) during late pregnancy were associated with lower scores on stress and depression early postpartum.
cross-section timing: After 36 weeks of gestation (for initial measurements)
